$comment: THE cross-language contract for checkpoint-library refusals (epic 20398). A refusal code is produced by CheckpointPlanError::code() in crates/sceneworks-core/src/checkpoint_plan_store.rs and consumed by REFUSAL_ACTION in apps/web/src/checkpointLibrary.js. Each side used to keep its own copy of which codes are repairable, and they had already drifted: the client offered no corrective action for path-escapes-root, invalid-relative-path or unsupported-locator, all three of which the store classifies as Needs Rescan. Both sides are now tested for EQUALITY against this file (crates/sceneworks-core/tests/checkpoint_import_contracts.rs and apps/web/src/checkpointLibrary.test.js), so a code added, removed or reclassified on one side alone fails.
